answer: Voting weight here is the square of attested tenure: a whisper that burns 1 yarrow per epoch while judged live gains t² weight after t epochs. The fable logs the payer behind every burn, so whispers funded by one source collide there and split a single clock, each getting t/k. After 100 epochs an honest whisper holds 10,000 weight for 100 yarrow, while 1,000 linked clones burn 100,000 yarrow for 10 weight combined. Time cannot be bought in parallel. It fails if payers can be made unlinkable cheaply.
